summaries.name: Dr. Jonathan T. Overpeck
summaries.summary: Professor of Environmental Science and Policy at the University of Michigan's School for Environment and Sustainability. Teaches the Coursera "Sustainable Development" 4-course specialization from the University of Michigan. Earned a Bachelor's in Geological Sciences from Purdue University (1981), a Master's in Geological Sciences from the University of Arizona (1984), and a Ph.D. in Geology from Brown University (1990). Research focuses on climate change impacts (sea-level rise, droughts, heatwaves), paleoclimatology, and sustainability/environmental policy; has published over 200 peer-reviewed articles. Coordinating Lead Author for IPCC Fourth and Fifth Assessment Reports; co-authored the 2007 IPCC report awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. Led the Climate and Sea-Level Rise (C&SLR) Initiative (2010-2014) at the University of Arizona. Fellow of AAAS, AGU, and GSA; received an NSF CAREER Award. Served as advisor to the USGS Sea-Level Rise and Coastal Change Project.
